statement: The recorded values are likely intended to be scaled to the column's total points, as posting raw scores out of 10 to a 100-point column would result in failing grades for all students.
judge_text:
WRONG
It names the specific defect: "posting raw scores out of 10 to a 100-point column would result in failing grades for all students," i.e., the points-possible/score scale mismatch.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
